name: Estival-Holm
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by towering mountain ranges. Beyond tectonic rift valleys, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.

The air carries ozone and crushed stone, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts. Small darting fauna nest in the cliff-vents, timing their flights between gusts.
Instruments disagree about the signal of unknown origin: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
